messages:
maya: heads up — when we surface fallback counts on per-route/per-model cards, I worry teams will misinterpret numbers and ops will see token spikes. can we avoid counting every fallback as a full request in billing/preview?
eli: yep. proposal: emit a dedicated 'model.fallback' telemetry event and apply server-side sampling. keep it separate from model.request so previews stay conservative.
sam: UX thought: saved queries should persist a small config: {includeFallbacks:bool, fallbackSample:percent}. default show = off for cost, on for diagnostics.
tessa: telemetry schema idea: model.fallback events carry: route_id, primary, fallback, reason, tokens_est, sample_pct, region, tier. sample_pct on the event so analytics can scale.
zara: important: include `routing_policy_id` — otherwise you can't tie a fallback to a specific policy change during a rollout.
eli: minimal example in logs:
```
evt=model.fallback;route=rc-42;primary=redwood-1;fallback=redwood-1-quant;reason=capacity;tokens=28;sample=0.02;policy=rp_2024_05;region=us-west;tier=dedicated
```
sam: in Console UI: per-route card add a small stat line "Fallbacks (sampled 2%): 0.5% rate". clicking opens controls: toggle include/exclude, adjust sample (if allowed), link to raw-samples (export).
maya: we need confidence intervals shown when sample_pct < 100. even a simple Clopper-Pearson or normal approx margin is fine. show "0.5% ±0.3% (95% CI)".
tessa: agree. add a tooltip explaining that small sample sizes give wide margins. also add a "request full capture" CTA that triggers an org-guardrail check.
zara: platform guardrail: block saved queries that request sample_pct > org_max (default 5%). require org-admin opt-in for >5% or full capture. also quota-throttle the raw-samples export.
eli: implement capture_level param: capture_level=org_default|admin_optin|force. if capture_level requires admin, API returns 403 with reason and UI shows modal.
sam: for sharing: when a saved query with higher-than-default sampling is shared, Console should show a red badge: "Requires admin opt-in to reproduce". prevents accidental org-wide spikes.
maya: rollout UX: if a routing policy change enables new fallback rules, Console route views should show a transient banner: "Fallbacks now active for this route (canary). Data sampled — expand for more" linking to rollout diff.
deploy-bot: rollout: routing-policy/rp_2024_05 canary -> 10% @ 2024-05-10T14:00Z.
tessa: metrics implication: don't mix sampled fallback events into overall model latency histograms unless scaled. keep sampled metrics in a separate series and offer scaled estimates with a warning.
ez: eli + raj should coordinate on how to represent tokens_used scaling — best to estimate tokens by multiplying sampled tokens by 1/sample_pct, but tag estimates as such.
eli: noted. server-side will attach sample_pct and a boolean `is_estimate` when scaling.
sam: small accessibility note: make the fallback pill keyboard-navigable and ensure tooltip content is readable.
maya: action list: eli implement event + sample_pct tagging + capture_level param, zara add routing_policy_id + org guardrail flags, sam wire the pill/toggle + saved-query metadata and share-state handling, tessa add CI and separate series for sampled metrics. I'll draft RFC and ping infra for quota config.
eli: starting schema PR now.
sam: will drop initial mocks in #design by EOD.
tessa: adding analytic tickets.
zara: will propose org_max default and admin opt-in flow.
maya: thanks all — paste PR/links back here and I'll merge RFC after comments.
